desc: When enemies come back, the same in every game: each player free in Petal Meadows (story 11, TTYD_SYNC_PICK -1). The host, alone in hei_02, beats an enemy there (its defeat recorded in both games) and stays. The guest walks hei_03 -> hei_04 -> hei_03 -> hei_02: its own game's rule (the open field keeps only the map and the one before it) forgot hei_02's record at hei_04, but the host's game keeps it, so the guest's hei_02 loads with the enemy gone (0.5.0: back alive in the guest's game, gone in the host's: the room's digest found it as a drift every few minutes, the soak's 'defeats recorded there, not here'). Then both leave for hei_04, nobody keeps hei_02's record any more, both games forget its record, so the host, back first, finds its enemies back and the guest finds the same room when it follows. No DRIFT in either game
